metadata.description:
The Holy Spirit Brings Together Life - Turning the World Upside Down

This is not a "children’s bible" or a "children’s translation".

This is good ol’ fashioned storytelling much like you’d do around a campfire or while tucking a child into bed.

Our hope is to share with children the Alive and Active Word (Hebrews 4:12) that aims to get at the motives of why people (adults AND children!) do what they do.

All videos free forever on BibleStoriesOnline.com and YouTube.
